name: Notion
soft_passes: #1 mask: composes cleanly onto a white squircle but delivered field-less (transparent logomark, not the Dock render)
#2 grid: optically centered horizontally but bleeds to y=0 and y=1024, no safe-zone margin as a raw asset
#3 silhouette: outer form reads as a block, but the N and white faces are negative space that vanish when filled solid black
#5 light: passes by having no modeled light at all (flat isometric); no era specular/refraction cues
#9 era: internally consistent flat mark but era-detached from macOS (not Big Sur squircle, not Liquid Glass)
#12 no-text: single-letter serif monogram with strong shape logic, acceptable per monogram rule
failures: #10 variant robustness: black keylines + black left-face on a white-dependent field; collapses in dark/tinted/clear renders, no baked dark variant

palette.background: flat #FFFFFF (transparent as delivered; white squircle field when composed as the app icon)

light_model: Flat / 2.5D axonometric with no modeled light source; left face is a flat solid-black tonal plane (not a cast shadow), top and front faces white; no gradient, specular, or baked drop shadow
layer_stack: black isometric cube shell + left dark face
devices: the N-block: serif capital N on the front face of an isometric notebook-block (object-monogram hybrid = 'a block of notes')
monochrome-only identity, zero hue families, no accent in the mark
isometric/axonometric projection instead of front-facing (breaks Big Sur front-plane convention)
keyline-as-depth-system: one chunky black outline does all structural work, no shading or bevel
recessed rounded-rect white label plate framing the glyph
rhymes_hint: Monochrome letterform/monogram logomarks that rely on a white field and ignore macOS era conventions (favicon-class marks promoted to app icons), plus isometric-object marks; opposite pole from the Big Sur diagonal-tool squircle family and the Liquid Glass layered-glass family
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: delivered asset is the transparent brand logomark (1024x1024, alpha), NOT the shipping macOS Dock render. The real Notion.app icon = this black cube on a solid white squircle; macapp.supply served the field-less web mark. Art is clean vector (alpha histogram bimodal 0/255, thin AA fringe) — no resolution smear, dimensions honest. Content bbox x 18->1006 (centered) but full vertical bleed y 0->1024 (no margin). Pure #000000/#FFFFFF only, verified by pixel sampling. Cover confirms monochrome-core brand: accent color (cornflower blue 'Think' pill, red/yellow avatar rings) appears only in UI, never in the mark. This is a single-appearance icon with no era participation — treat as an outlier when clustering; do not let its transparent-mark grid/mask behavior contaminate squircle-era canon.
